theme_central: A verifiable geopolitical prophecy (the Romans' victory) opens the surah to establish the message's credibility, before a long meditation on the signs of creation.

branches.title: Prophecy of the Romans
branches.resume: The defeated Romans will triumph within a few years — Allah's promise, verifiable.

children.t: Prophecy of the Romans' victory over the Persians within a few years

branches.title: Reflection, resurrection, glorification
branches.resume: Injustice of denying the resurrection, division between believers and disbelievers, glorifying Allah morning and evening.

children.t: Reflecting on oneself, injustice of denying the resurrection
Glorifying Allah morning and evening, bringing the living out of the dead

branches.title: Signs of marriage, diversity
branches.resume: Tenderness and compassion between spouses, diversity of languages and colors, warning against sects.

children.t: Signs of marriage, diversity of languages and colors, sleep
Parable of slaves compared to the partners attributed to Allah; not to divide religion into sects

branches.title: Ingratitude, rights of relatives, riba
branches.resume: Man's ingratitude in times of ease, rights of relatives and the poor, prohibition of riba, corruption on earth.

children.t: Man's ingratitude in ease after distress
Rights of relatives and the poor, riba brings no increase with Allah
Corruption appeared on land and sea because of what people's hands have earned

branches.title: The winds, the resurrection
branches.resume: Winds bearing good news, raising the dead just as the earth comes back to life after rain.

children.t: Winds bearing rain, resurrection compared to the earth coming back to life

branches.title: Stages of life, closing
branches.resume: Weakness, strength, then weakness again; final patience asked of the Prophet.

children.t: Stages of human life, fate of the unjust, final patience asked
